add.k: Vuk's second in command among the D'Bari
st: In 1992, Jones greets Vuk on Earth and tells her the power is inside a young mutant, then dies in the D'Bari attack on the train.

files.notes: Credited name Jones (Ato Essandoh; Wikipedia: 'Vuk's second in command'). Transcript dark-phoenix: 'Greetings, Vuk.' / 'With ease.' / 'The power is being contained inside one of them... She's stronger. A mutant. She has no idea what's happening to her.' The X-Men Movies wiki (seen via search) gives these report lines to Jones, and themoviespoiler.com calls him Vuk's associate. He dies in the D'Bari attack on the mutants' train (the wiki: Magneto crushes the car he is in; Screen Rant: Magneto crushes train cars full of D'Bari; Wikipedia: Jean disintegrates the remaining D'Bari). Group 'The D'Bari' is the app's name; the 'D'Bari Empire' is said on screen.

st: In 1975, Elaine rides with John and young Jean as the radio keeps changing, until Jean's powers crash the car and kill her.

files.notes: Credited name Elaine Grey (Wikipedia: 'Hannah Emily Anderson appears as Jean's mother Elaine'). Lines in the car scene ('- John.' '- Wasn't me.' 'Jean, was that... Did you?'); speakers are not marked in the subtitles, so the step does not quote her. Her daughter later learns John survived; Elaine did not. No group: Independent.

add.k: An orderly at the Essex House mutant orphanage
st: Daniel stands with the headmaster as Russell rages at Essex House, until Wade sees the boy was abused and shoots him dead.

files.notes: Credited name Daniel Frye; his first name is also said: Wade asks 'It is Glen, isn't it?' and he answers 'Daniel.' (transcript deadpool-2). Wade then asks Russell 'Those guys hurt you? ... Baldilocks? Jared Kushner? Both of 'em?', shoots him, and shouts 'That kid was abused!'; Wade and Russell are taken to the Ice Box. Group follows the app's 'The Essex Corporation' used for the headmaster; the film names only 'Essex House for Mutant Rehabilitation'.

add.k: An enforcer for the Canewood company
st: Jackson calls Will a trespasser at his water pump until Logan runs his men off, then comes back at night and X-24 kills him.

files.notes: Credited name Jackson (Lennie Loftin, per the Marvel Movies wiki cast list; Wikipedia only says Logan 'drives off enforcers from a corporate farm'). Lines (transcript logan): 'Good evening, Mr. Munson... you're trespassing right now', 'Looks like Mr Munson hired some muscle', and at night 'Will Munson! ... Munson, goddammit, come out here!' and 'Canewood can start you at Five G.' Group 'Canewood' is said on screen ('Canewood beverage bought everything up'). Not in groups_in_app. That night he mistakes X-24 for Logan ('There's that asshole'), offers him Canewood work, and X-24 decapitates him and kills his men (filmsite.org plot; transcript: 'Oh shit! Shoot him!'), so Deceased.

add.k: Dani's father on the Cheyenne reservation
st: William hides Dani as their reservation is torn apart and goes back to help the others, but the Demon Bear kills him.
In a vision inside Dani's mind, William tells her it was not her fault and that she must wake up and face the bear.

files.notes: Credited name William Lonestar (Wikipedia: 'Adam Beach as William Lonestar: Dani's father'). Lines marked DANI'S FATHER in the transcript: 'Here! Hide here! I have to go help them', 'Run! No! Get away!' and in the climax 'It wasn't your fault. But now you need to wake up.' / 'You're bigger.' Killer per the Marvel Movies wiki; the film reveals the bear, not a tornado, destroyed the reservation. No group: Independent.

add.k: Erik's mother, held in a Nazi camp in 1944
st: In 1944, guards drag Edie and her husband into a Nazi camp away from her young son, whose power bends the iron gate.
In 1944, Schmidt orders young Erik to move a coin, and Edie tells her son all is well before Schmidt shoots her.

files.notes: Credited name: X-Men: First Class credits Eva Magyar as 'Edie Lensherr' (IMDb/TMDB), the family name the films and the app spell Lehnsherr; X-Men (2000) credits Rhona Shekter as 'Magneto's Mother'. 'Eisenhardt' is only the wiki's name for her (its own page gives the alias Edie Lehnsherr). First Class lines (transcript x-men-first-class): 'My darling. How are you?', 'You can do it', 'Everything is all right.' In X-Men (2000) she appears only in the wordless gate scene, so that step has no lines of hers; the boy is the young Magneto. No group: Independent.

add.k: Travis's wife, who takes in Logan at their farm
st: Heather spots a naked stranger in the barn, sets supper for Logan and admires him in her son's jacket, then Agent Zero shoots her.

files.notes: Credited name Heather Hudson (Wikipedia: 'Julia Blake portrayed ... Heather Hudson'). Lines (transcript x-men-origins-wolverine): 'Travis! I think there is some naked man in the barn', 'Supper's on the table', 'Good morning! Oh, it fits you beautifully!' The group file The Hudsons (fox-hudsons) stays, per the 8 November rule. No group: Independent, as for Travis.

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
stages.text: Jones greets Vuk when she reaches Earth and reports what he has learned. He tells her the power they hunt is inside a young mutant who does not understand it, and Vuk sees a way to use her.
stages.whoA: The D'Bari leader he reports to

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
stages.text: In 1975, young Jean rides in the family car with her mother, Elaine, and the radio keeps changing. Jean's powers flare out of control and crash the car, and Elaine dies.
stages.whoA: Her daughter, whose powers cause the crash
stages.whoB: Her mother, killed in the 1975 crash

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
stages.text: Elaine and her husband, John, drive with their daughter Jean in 1975. Jean's powers crash the car, killing Elaine, while John survives.
stages.whoA: Her husband, who survives the crash
stages.whoB: His wife, killed in the 1975 crash

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Wade arrives at Essex House as an X-Men trainee and mocks Daniel while trying to calm Russell. Sure the boy was abused, Wade shoots Daniel dead, and Wade and Russell are sent to the Ice Box.
stages.whoA: The X-Men trainee who shoots him
stages.whoB: The Essex House orderly he shoots dead

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Russell rages at Essex House while Daniel and the headmaster wait to take him back inside. Wade asks Russell if the staff hurt him, then kills Daniel.
stages.whoA: The young mutant in his care
stages.whoB: An orderly at the orphanage that hurt him

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Daniel stands beside the headmaster as police and the X-Men face Russell at Essex House. The headmaster insists the boy belongs in their care, until Wade shoots Daniel.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Jackson and his Canewood men block Will's water pump and call him a trespasser, but Logan runs them off. Jackson returns to the farm that night with guns, shouting for Will.
stages.whoA: The farmer who will not sell to Canewood
stages.whoB: The Canewood enforcer at his pump

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: At Will's water pump, Jackson calls Logan hired muscle and will not leave. Logan counts to three and breaks the rifle, and Jackson's men flee.
stages.whoA: Will's guest who beats his men
stages.whoB: A Canewood enforcer he runs off

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Jackson returns to the Munson farm at night and mistakes X-24 for Logan, offering him work with Canewood. X-24 ignores the offer and kills Jackson and his men.
stages.whoA: The clone who kills him at the farm
stages.whoB: A Canewood enforcer he kills at the farm

stages.title: The New Mutants
stages.text: William hides his daughter Dani as their reservation is destroyed and goes back to help others, and he dies. Later, in a vision, he tells her it was not her fault and that she must wake up and face the bear.
stages.whoB: Her father, killed on the reservation

stages.title: The New Mutants
stages.text: The Demon Bear tears through the reservation and kills William as he tries to help. In Dani's mind he urges her to face the bear, and she takes control of it.
stages.whoB: Dani's father, one of its victims

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: In 1944, guards pull Edie away from her young son at the gate of a Nazi camp. As they drag her off, his power bends the iron gate toward her.
stages.whoA: Her son, torn from her at the camp
stages.whoB: His mother, taken from him in 1944

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Edie is pulled from Erik at the camp gate, then brought to Schmidt's office. She tells Erik everything is all right, and Schmidt shoots her when he cannot move the coin.
stages.whoA: Her son Erik, forced to watch her die

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: Schmidt has Edie brought to his office and counts to three while Erik tries to move a coin. When the coin stays still, he shoots her to unlock Erik's anger.
stages.whoA: The Nazi doctor who shoots her

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Heather and her husband Travis take the stranger Logan into their farmhouse, feed him and give him their son's clothes. The next morning Agent Zero kills them both.
stages.whoB: His wife, who sets supper for Logan

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Heather spots Logan naked in the barn, and she and Travis give him clothes, supper and a bed. The next morning she admires him in her son's jacket just before Agent Zero shoots her.
stages.whoB: The farmer's wife who takes him in

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Agent Zero tracks Logan to the farm and opens fire. He kills Heather and Travis while hunting the man they sheltered.
stages.whoA: The Weapon X gunman who kills her
stages.whoB: An old woman he kills hunting Logan

So her credited name is Edie Lehnsherr.

changes.was: Credited name Abraham Cornelius (David Ritchie, per the Marvel Movies wiki cast list). The procedure lines ('Body temperature is 108 and rising', 'Heartbeat is close to maximum', 'Adamantium reservoir is depleted. No rejection. Procedure completed.') are in the transcript, but the subtitles have no speakers and a second scientist (Carol Frost) is in the room, so which lines are his rests on the reviewer's summary. Group 'Weapon X' is named on screen ('Today, we're gonna create Weapon X'). Not seen again, so Active.
changes.now: Credited name Abraham Cornelius (David Ritchie, Marvel Movies wiki cast list; Wikipedia's Abraham Cornelius page confirms the role). The subtitles have no speakers. Procedure completed.' call, but no source pins them to him, so the step does not quote him. Group 'Weapon X' is named on screen ('Today, we're gonna create Weapon X'). Not seen again, so Active.
